overview: A single-file Arabic RTL mobile UI showcase for صديقك, a study companion app for Iraqi high-school students, presenting twelve phone screens with four switchable color themes.
features: Twelve mobile screens in labeled 390x844 phone frames
Onboarding, home, booklets store, booklet detail, and reader
Exam setup, exam question, and exam result screens
Login, logout confirmation, account, and settings screens
Four switchable color themes: mint, ocean, lavender, and dark
Original صديقك logo and CSS/SVG book covers
Inline outline SVG icons with no external images
